title_zh: 杨利伟：中国第一位航天员
title_en: Famous Chinese People (6/20): Yang Liwei, China's First Astronaut
note_en: Even orbits need a measure word: 他绕地球飞行了十四圈 "he orbited the Earth fourteen times." 圈 (quān) means "circle, lap," and it counts trips around something, just like laps around a track (跑了三圈 "ran three laps"). It goes after the verb, where English would say "fourteen times" or "fourteen orbits."
